name: Michelle Cervantez
reason: Her only website is Hendo Care Farm (hendocarefarm.com), a therapeutic care-farm brand she co-owns whose equine programme page sells its work on conditions (says horse work is effective for depression, anxiety, PTSD, ADHD, substance abuse and autism), so a listing would send people there (strict health rule); the published email is also the farm's general inbox, and her Insight Timer bio frames her meditations as energy healing for body and energy.
